lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Fixed two reviewer-flagged false-negative gaps in findStoreReachingSearch (src/issues/self-contaminating-search.ts), the same module US-R1-001 already touched for a false-positive fix: (1) applyToken only special-cased 'token === "--recursive"' as the long form of a recursive flag, missing -R's OWN documented long spelling '--dereference-recursive' (GNU grep man page: '-R, --dereference-recursive'), so 'grep --dereference-recursive zzqqx scripts' walked past unflagged; fixed by accepting both spellings in the same LONG_FLAG_RE branch. (2) isStoreReachingRoot normalized only a leading './' and a trailing slash before comparing against the relative STORE_PATH constant, so an absolute root like '/Users/me/repo/scripts' never matched (no relative-path transform makes an absolute path equal a relative one); fixed by branching on a leading '/': if the absolute root starts with the live process.cwd(), strip that prefix and fall through to the existing relative check, otherwise fall back to a new matchesStoreSuffix() helper that suffix-matches STORE_PATH's ancestor prefixes ('scripts', 'scripts/cam', 'scripts/cam/issues') each guarded by a '/' boundary (so '/repo/other-scripts' does not falsely match '/repo/scripts'). Added 5 new tests to test/issues/self-contaminating-search.test.ts: --dereference-recursive flagged, an absolute root outside cwd flagged (suffix-match path), an absolute root actually under process.cwd() flagged (cwd-strip path), an absolute-under-cwd non-store root correctly NOT flagged, and the '/repo/other-scripts' near-miss correctly NOT flagged. Did not touch prd-oracle-lint.ts or its tests: that module only imports and wraps findStoreReachingSearch, so fixing the shared core transparently fixes both call sites (validateSpec filing-time guardrail and the plan-time lint rule) with zero duplicated logic, consistent with the US-002/US-003 design intent recorded in patterns.md. No pattern-records.jsonl file exists in this repo yet (checked again, same as prior story), so appliedPatternIds is omitted. check:all is fully green: test 5855/5855 (+5 net from this story's additions), embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, skip-ratchet all ok. Did not touch prd.json.
